designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1996 under the Endangered Species Act to protect coastal sage scrub, vernal pools and other habitat for listed species east of San Diego.

authority.citation: Endangered Species Act of 1973 (land acquisition authority)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: San Diego National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, May 24, 2006 (E6-7911): "The San Diego National Wildlife Refuge (Refuge) was established in 1996 under the authority of the Endangered Species Act of 1973"

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Established in 1996, the refuge spans more than 12,445 acres from the city of Jamul to neighborhoods in Spring Valley and eastern Chula Vista.
